name: libopenmpt
desc: Software library to decode tracked music files
why: Decodes decades of tracker module formats, a window into an unusual music culture, though it is a library first.

brief.what_it_is: libopenmpt is a cross-platform C++ and C library that decodes tracked music files (modules) into a raw PCM audio stream. It takes a module file as input and produces decoded audio samples for a host program to play or process. openmpt123 is a companion cross-platform command-line and terminal module player built on libopenmpt. The library is based on the player code of the OpenMPT project (Open ModPlug Tracker).
brief.why_it_exists: The homepage frames it as a way to decode tracker module music in cross-platform software, and says it avoids code base fragmentation by being developed in the same repository as OpenMPT.
brief.standout: It reuses the player code of the OpenMPT tracker rather than maintaining a separate decoder, and it ships a libmodplug-compatible layer (libopenmpt-modplug) so older software written against libmodplug can use it. It also has a plugin for the XMPlay player and a long tail of player and language-binding integrations listed on a wiki page.
brief.status: maintained. The homepage news lists releases on 2025-05-31, 2025-06-14, 2025-07-19, 2025-09-06, 2025-12-14, 2026-03-22, 2026-03-24, 2026-05-17, 2026-08-15 and a security update on 2026-08-19, with multiple release branches (0.8, 0.7, 0.6, 0.5, 0.4) still receiving updates.
brief.caveats: The homepage describes the Winamp (in_openmpt) and foobar2000 (foo_openmpt) plugins as deprecated, in favour of WACUP or Winamp's own libopenmpt-based plugin and foo_openmpt54, a fork. The homepage does not describe install or build steps, and I did not reach a README or repository, so build details are unverified. The brew description and scout notes both frame it as a library first, with openmpt123 as the player.
quotes: libopenmpt is a cross-platform C++ and C library to decode tracked music files (modules) [wikipedia] into a raw PCM audio stream.
openmpt123 is a cross-platform command-line or terminal based module file player.
In order to avoid code base fragmentation, libopenmpt is developed in the same source code repository as OpenMPT.
